description: Lists the rubrics in the active workspace (id, name, description, criterion count). Check here BEFORE caliper_rubrics_create — reuse an existing rubric's id in caliper_evals_create when one already scores the same job. Read a rubric's criteria with caliper_rubrics_get.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: caliper_rubrics_list
title: List Caliper rubrics
